findingClass: pull-model verification check PULL-PLAN: plan rows per IPO = the committed manifest, and the manifest hash is unchanged
whatItAsks: plan rows per IPO = the committed manifest, and the manifest hash is unchanged
alarmsWhen: any mismatch, or a manifest hash that moved without a commit
scope: phase-1 IPOs, MAINBOARD + SME, prod + staging slots (docs/design/data-sourcing-pull-model.md §2.1)
consumerReason: the plan is rebuilt every pull cycle (§2.1) — a manifest drift is a per-cycle structural fact, read by identity (IPO, plan row) each slot, not a trend accumulated overnight
status: designed, not yet built — specified by docs/design/data-sourcing-pull-model.md; build item 10 (owner decision OD-42: "a check nobody reads is no detection")
sourceDesign: docs/design/data-sourcing-pull-model.md §4 ("How we would know it worked")
